svg.aria-label: Left: mean KL and sampled reconstruction MSE for three β values, using 32 latent draws for each of 360 test images. Right: ordinary and denoising AEs with the same 8D bottleneck, reading clean or fixed noisy inputs and targeting clean images. All measurements use the same split.
